label: Bible Study
prompt: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, _____ not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verse: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
note: Hebrews quotes Psalm 95 — today is always the day to listen.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have _____ thee, and not cast thee away.
verse: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
note: God to Israel: I have chosen thee and not cast thee away — called from the ends of the earth.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil _____.
verse: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
note: The oil kept pouring until every borrowed vessel was full — then it stayed, the moment the jars ran out.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the _____ of all people:
verse: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
note: God didn't choose Israel for its size — it was the smallest nation, loved simply because he loved them.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the _____, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
verse: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
note: 'Comfort the feebleminded' — the fainthearted. Warn some, comfort others, support the weak: care fits the person.
